journey.name: quickpay payment pin
journey.description:
When a PIN is required for payments, turning QuickPay on or raising either QuickPay limit asks for the same PIN (or biometrics) as Send before anything is saved, and a cancelled check leaves the old value. Turning QuickPay off and lowering a limit never ask.
Precondition: onboarded dev wallet, start on the wallet home screen. Enable a PIN you choose under Settings ▸ Security ▸ PIN Code and turn on "Also require for payments" (testTag "ToggleBioForPayments"); no biometrics enrolled on the device, so the PIN pad shows directly. QuickPay is off with the default limits: $5 a payment and 5× a day. Never enter a wrong PIN more than once.
The PIN pad is drawn over the QuickPay screen and reads "Please enter your PIN code to confirm this QuickPay change." The slider stops are their labels under each slider: "$1" to "$50" for the amount (testTag "QuickpayAmountSlider") and "1×" to "50×" for the daily limit (testTag "QuickpayDailyLimitSlider"). Read the current values from the text above each slider rather than the knob position.

actions.action: Tap the menu button (testTag "HeaderMenu") and tap Settings (testTag "DrawerSettings")
Tap the General tab (testTag "Tab-general") and tap QuickPay (testTag "QuickpaySettings")
If the QuickPay intro shows, tap its Continue button (testTag "QuickpayIntro-button")
Verify the Enable QuickPay switch (testTag "QuickpayToggle") is off and the text reads "below $5"
Tap the Enable QuickPay switch (testTag "QuickpayToggle")
Verify the PIN pad shows and reads "Please enter your PIN code to confirm this QuickPay change.", then press back
Verify the QuickPay screen is showing and the Enable QuickPay switch (testTag "QuickpayToggle") is still off
Tap the Enable QuickPay switch (testTag "QuickpayToggle") again and enter the PIN
Verify the PIN pad is gone and the Enable QuickPay switch (testTag "QuickpayToggle") is on
Tap the "$20" stop under the amount slider (testTag "QuickpayAmountSlider")
Verify the PIN pad shows, then press back
Verify the text above the amount slider still reads "below $5"
Tap the "$20" stop under the amount slider again and enter the PIN
Verify the text above the amount slider reads "below $20" and the daily text reads "Pay up to $100 per day"
Tap the "10×" stop under the daily limit slider (testTag "QuickpayDailyLimitSlider")
Verify the PIN pad shows, then press back
Verify the daily text still reads "Pay up to $100 per day"
Tap the "$1" stop under the amount slider (testTag "QuickpayAmountSlider")
Verify no PIN pad shows, the text above the amount slider reads "below $1" and the daily text reads "Pay up to $5 per day"
Tap the Enable QuickPay switch (testTag "QuickpayToggle")
Verify no PIN pad shows and the Enable QuickPay switch (testTag "QuickpayToggle") is off
Tap the "$5" stop under the amount slider, enter the PIN, and verify the text reads "below $5"
Press back (again past the intro, if it was shown) and verify the QuickPay row (testTag "QuickpaySettings") reads "Off"
